category.title: Category
category.description: Which FDA-regulated product category to search.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Free-text search across the product description and recall reason (e.g. "salmonella", "infusion pump", "undeclared peanut"). Leave blank to skip keyword filtering.

classification.title: Severity classification
classification.description: FDA's own severity tier: Class I = reasonable chance of serious harm/death, Class II = temporary/reversible harm, Class III = unlikely to cause harm.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter US state code to limit to recalls from firms based there (e.g. "CA"). Leave blank for all states.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, based on FDA report date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of recalls to return, most recent first.
